articles.title: Congress leader booked under POCSO - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: Anand Naidu, general secretary of the Bengaluru North District Congress Committee (DCC), has been booked by the Mahalakshmi Layout police for allegedly assaulting minor children.  The complaint alleges that Naidu was in an illicit relationship with the complainant's wife for three years and assaulted his children when they questioned the relationship. The children have accused Naidu of using a rod and biting them, causing injuries. The police have registered a case and initiated an investigation.
articles.civic_flag_reason: Alleged abuse of power and potential harm to children by a prominent political figure warrants urgent concern.
